# কাবার পথে (Kaaba r Pothe)

> Bangladesh-based Hajj & Umrah booking platform. Saudi Ministry-licensed, scholar-led group tours. Trusted by 50,000+ pilgrims since 2015.

Kaaba r Pothe Travels is a licensed Hajj & Umrah agency headquartered in Dhanmondi, Dhaka. Packages span Economy, Standard, Premium, and VIP tiers for Hajj 2026 and year-round Umrah. All packages include round-trip flights, Saudi visa, 3–5 star hotels near Haram, ziyarah tours, meals, and scholar guidance.

## Site

- [Home](https://www.kaabarpothe.com/): Overview, featured packages, testimonials.
- [Hajj Packages](https://www.kaabarpothe.com/packages/hajj): 2026 Hajj tiers — Economy, Standard, Premium, VIP.
- [Umrah Packages](https://www.kaabarpothe.com/packages/umrah): Budget, Economy, Premium, Luxury Umrah.
- [Transportation](https://www.kaabarpothe.com/transportation): Airport transfers, intercity coach, ziyarah tours, Haram shuttle.
- [Reviews](https://www.kaabarpothe.com/reviews): Verified pilgrim testimonials.
- [FAQ](https://www.kaabarpothe.com/faq): Booking, deposit, refund, visa, itinerary answers.
- [About](https://www.kaabarpothe.com/about): Agency history, credentials, scholar team.
- [Contact](https://www.kaabarpothe.com/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, email, office address.

## Trust

- Licensed by the Saudi Ministry of Hajj & Umrah
- Scholar-led (Alem-guided) groups
- 25% deposit booking (30% for VIP); balance in 2–6 monthly installments
- Full refund up to 60 days before departure
- Bengali + English multilingual support, 24/7
